title: Create src/tui/components/CompletionReport.tsx
description: Create the Ink component rendered when a task completes successfully. Shows a green success header, task title, iteration count, total elapsed time, and per-iteration timing breakdown.
acceptanceCriteria: Total elapsed time is formatted as Xm Ys

steps.details: Create the file. Define props type: { taskTitle: string; taskId: number; iterations: number; totalElapsedMs: number; iterationTimings: number[] }
function formatTime(ms: number): string { const mins = Math.floor(ms / 60000); const secs = Math.floor((ms % 60000) / 1000); return `${mins}m ${secs}s` }

Render: <Box flexDirection='column' marginTop={1}><Text bold color='green'>✅ Task Complete</Text><Text>Task: #{taskId} {taskTitle}</Text><Text>Iterations: {iterations}</Text><Text>Total time: {formatTime(totalElapsedMs)}</Text><Text bold marginTop={1}>Per-iteration timing:</Text>{iterationTimings.map((ms, i) => <Text key={i}>  Iteration {i+1}: {formatTime(ms)}</Text>)}</Box>
